verdict.rationale: Community reports show Solid has runnable code: a live playground widget on the landing page and interactive examples such as CSS animations and todo. Both are described as buggy (the playground shows only a sliver of code, and examples failed to load on Android Chrome), and one long-time user calls the docs lacking. Missing for 10: any evidence of an interactive API reference, first-party documentation of runnable examples tied to API entries, and reliable cross-device working examples.
